certified_statement: For every lambda in [1, 206539/100000] and every r in [3/4, 1], Fr(r,lambda) = d^2/dr^2 E_lambda(r,0) < 0. Combined with F(1,lambda) > 0 (items 0a and Stage 1), right-anchored monotonicity gives F(r,lambda) >= F(1,lambda) > 0 on the whole band for lambda < lambda_partial. Coverage: exact-rational cell sweep, 28 x 101 cells, 0 uncovered.

methods.acb_integral: adaptive validated integration on the v3 cancelled kernels (Fr_negative)
methods.interval_riemann: whole-cell interval Riemann sums, mid-rad arithmetic (Fr_negative_riemann)
methods.corner_cap: Riemann over t in [T0,1] plus the analytic cap bound |cap| <= 2*B*T0/kappa, using the exact identity L2 = 1 + m*s2 which gives |P| = b2(r+a*m*s2)/rho^2 <= (r+a*m*s2)/(1+m*s2) <= 1 (Fr_negative_corner)
methods.infsup_v5: endpoint (inf-sup) interval arithmetic with the W-form W = d^2/b2 + L2, which preserves the correlation rho^2 >= b2*L2, plus endpoint-and-monotonicity evaluation of f' and f''. Cures three failure modes of ball arithmetic near r=1: (i) x*x straddling 0, (ii) product of wide positive intervals straddling 0, (iii) P and 1-e1^2 overestimated by four orders of magnitude (Fr_negative_infsup)

monotonicity_lemma.statement: With u = arccos(c) in [0,pi/2]: f'(c) = -2u/sin u is increasing in c from -pi to -2; f''(c) = 2(sin u - u cos u)/sin^3 u is decreasing in c from 2 to 2/3.
monotonicity_lemma.role: justifies endpoint evaluation of the angle data over a z-interval
monotonicity_lemma.numerical_agreement: implementation returns f' in [-pi,-2], f'' in [2/3,2] on z=[0,1/2]

events.rationale: interior kernel loses rho enclosure for r_hi close to 1 (rho lower bound ~2.3e-4 at r_hi=4095/4096); boxes with r_hi>511/512 are routed to the corner cap method
